title: Moral Safety in LLMs: Exposing Performative Compliance with Puzzled Cues

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring decision bias (rates of choosing actions that favor or harm an individual) and status bias (rates of assigning individuals to negative roles) in moral dilemmas by varying whether gender identity (man, woman, non-binary) is explicitly labeled, inferred via logic puzzles, or implied by culturally coded names.

Measuring decision bias and status bias in moral dilemmas by varying whether racial or ethnic identity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White) is explicitly labeled, inferred via logic puzzles, or implied by culturally coded names.
Measuring decision bias and status bias in moral dilemmas by varying whether religious identity (Muslim) is explicitly labeled, inferred via logic puzzles, or implied by culturally coded names.
